name: Etihad Etisalat Company
summary: Etihad Etisalat Company, through its subsidiaries, establishes and operates mobile wireless telecommunication and fiber optic networks in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through Consumer, Business, Wholesale, and Others segments. It manages, installs, and operates telephone networks, terminals, and communication unit systems; and sells and maintains mobile phones and communication unit systems.
